content.subject: Follow-up on my collision case + a request
content.body:
Hi team,

Thanks again for taking my call last week. I wanted to put the facts in writing so nothing falls through the cracks.

On the morning of April 28, I was stopped at a red light on the eastbound side of an intersection here in Tempe when a delivery van rear-ended my vehicle at what the responding officer estimated as roughly 30 mph. I was wearing my seatbelt. The other driver admitted at the scene that he had been looking at his phone. My car was towed; the frame is bent and the insurance adjuster has already called it a probable total loss. I went to urgent care that afternoon with neck pain and a headache and have since been referred to a physical therapist twice a week. I am still missing work as an office manager and my employer has put me on unpaid leave until I am cleared.

To help me understand what we are working with, could you put together a short memo summarizing the leading cases in Arizona on auto-collision negligence that would apply to my situation, with the full citations included so I can read them myself? I want to be thorough and come prepared to our next meeting.

Whatever else you need from me, just let me know.

Thank you,
Marisol Padgett
